headline: 'Slippery slope' to draft embattled QB Sorsby, says Browns' Monken
description: Browns coach Todd Monken says it would be a "slippery slope" to draft Texas Tech quarterback Brendan Sorsby in the NFL's supplemental draft if he's ruled ineligible to play college football due to his gambling addiction.
